pickthall.translator: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain

verses.text: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion
That is he who repelleth the orphan
And urgeth not the feeding of the needy
Who are heedless of their prayer

yusufali.translator: Abdullah Yusuf Ali, The Holy Quran (1934), public domain

verses.text: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)
Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness)
And encourages not the feeding of the indigent
Who are neglectful of their prayers
Those who (want but) to be seen (of men)
